questions.prompt: How many cups of coffee are drunk worldwide each day?
reasoning: Roughly a billion coffee drinkers on Earth, averaging about two cups each.
It is one of the most consumed drinks on the planet.

questions.prompt: How many trees are on Earth?
reasoning: Satellite surveys plus ground plots suggest ~400 trees per person across 8 billion people.

questions.prompt: How long is the Great Wall of China, in kilometres?
reasoning: All branches and trenches measured together stretch halfway around the Earth.
Walking it end to end would take well over a year.
